question: Can the existing routed-v6 UniversalPolicy represent and optimize the first searched action on a small, fixed set of training observations?

data.source: Existing three-turn plan fit dataset, first sampled root position from each of 128 maps seed6451000 through6451127; no new maps or labels
data.label: First legal action index of the exact native three-turn selected completed plan. The cached and replanned teachers previously agreed on every tested first action at identical root state.
data.selection: Sort independent map seeds ascending, take exactly the first sampled record per seed, and copy its root BatchObservation and legal-action ordering once before optimization. Reject a missing or duplicate map.

optimization.initialization: Full routed-v6 Classic Generic two-player procedural_v1 expert
optimization.trainable: Every existing UniversalPolicy parameter; no architecture change
optimization.objective: Mean negative log probability of the fixed teacher legal-action index. No KL, data augmentation, trajectory replay, or terminal reward.
optimization.optimizer: AdamW learning rate0.0003, zero weight decay, batch size16, gradient norm clip1.0, deterministic shuffle seed6451000, exactly1024 updates with repeated fixed snapshots and no checkpoint selection
optimization.readouts: Exact same-snapshot argmax accuracy and mean teacher negative log probability at updates0,128,256,512,1024, including root-seat counts. Fixed snapshots are never refreshed.

interpretation: At least95% same-snapshot accuracy at update1024 establishes only that this network and recipe can memorize this specific fixed training set. Lower accuracy localizes a representation/optimization/label boundary for inspection, without proving which component failed. Neither outcome measures generalization, autonomous strength, Elo, or a deployable student. Do not change the recipe based on these readouts or run held-out gates from this diagnostic.
resources: Run only in SSH server fedora-toolbox scratch on one pinned CPU with nice19 and Rayon/BLAS thread caps, timeout1800 seconds, small JSON summary, no checkpoint retention. Verify dataset and source hashes, resource availability, and no concurrent heavy job first.
